class.name: SVGAnimate2D
class.brief_description: Editable and keyframeable SVG path node for 2D.
class.description: Exposes every existing SVG path anchor as paths/path_N/point_N and stores its cubic controls as in_handle/out_handle child properties. Anchor properties can be keyed by AnimationPlayer. Editor tools move existing anchors and handles without adding or deleting paths or points. Controls follow viewBox, preserveAspectRatio, group transforms, and path transforms. Enable animation_enabled for the same four-pattern hand-drawn jitter as SVG2D. Path edits preserve the jitter playback phase. Jitter affects rasterized outlines only: editor anchors, handles, hit positions and saved keyframes always use unjittered path coordinates. cache_animation_frames is disabled by default to reuse one texture during continuous path deformation. Enable it for static shapes when avoiding rerasterization is preferable.

method.name: flush_paths
method.description: Applies pending path edits immediately. Call before reading a texture when deferred_updates is enabled. SVGAnimate3D still refreshes its displayed texture at idle time.

members.member: Combines path edits until idle time, serializing and parsing the SVG once per batch. Point getters and scene saving always see current edits. Disable for immediate SVG parsing.
